releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.1.18

Hubble 1.1.18: reliable range cut/paste, faster headers and one LiveGrade connection

- Move selected cell ranges with Command-X and Command-V, including routing groups, overlapping moves, formulas and one-step Undo. Clear the cut highlight after a completed paste.
- Keep the existing table when actions are added, deleted, undone or redone, and make header expand/collapse controls available sooner after reload.
- Use one LiveGrade connection and choose LiveGrade Studio 6, LiveGrade 7 or LiveGrade Frontier when adding each action. Move actions to one connection before deleting duplicate connections.
- Improve layout-ID confirmations and offline Companion synchronization while preserving the readable Status Log, full Button layout editor, presets and module setup improvements.
